title: [End Replacer] - The Pee Dimension
description: Replaces The End with The Pee Dimension. Good for servers that ban The End.
body:
**Warning!!** - This datapack adds the Pee Dimension and replaces The End.


# To Install:

 - You must **move/delete** The End file on old saves (Any world that was not generated with the Pee Dimension installed).

 - The file in your world is called > **DIM1**.

 - The Same goes for removing the Pee Dimension

## What does this datapack do?

![A photo of the Pee Dimension. The liquid is a yellow and green colour.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/235efbb0de48af066673aa9eb67f049a3da7e3d6.png)

The Pee Dimension is intended for servers that ban the end. With it in place, any members of the server that enter the end are transported into the Pee Dimension.

Here they are trapped either until a moderator lets them out, or until they solve the Pee Book. Which holds the answer to the only method of escape.

  Moderators can release a player using a basic teleport command like:

    /tp <player name> @s

  Moderators who are stuck in The Dimension can use the command:

    /execute in minecraft:overworld run tp @s ~ ~ ~

![A photo of a Pee Island. One of the Dimension's necessities.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53d406b68f9058c93f0546a7ee852be0b0e359df_0.webp)
